english.title: Fail to give name and address to an accredited person - relevant offence - Police Reform
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having given a person accredited under the Police Reform Act 2002 reason to believe that you had committed a relevant offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT OFFENCE..), and having been required by that person to give your name and address, failed to comply with that requirement
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 2(2) and 2(3) of Schedule 5 to the Police Reform Act 2002.

english.notes:
IMPORTANTThis offence is ONLY AVAILABLE to accredited persons whose accreditation as specified by the Chief Officer of Police for the area in which that person operates includes paragraph 2 of Schedule 5 to the Police Reform Act 2002.

This wording should only be used where the individual fails to provide his name and address to an accredited person in relation to a relevant offence.
H4943 - fail to give name/address to accredited person - act in anti-social manner
H4944 - contravene accredited person's requirement to surrender liquor
H4945 - contravene accredited person's requirement not to consume liquor
H4946 - fail to stop vehicle as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
H4947 - drive vehicle - fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
H4948 - pedestrian fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load

other.powersofarrest: An accredited person DOES NOT have a power of arrest or to detain - however as with any criminal offence a police officer may arrest without warrant.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
